selection: Highest validation net account PnL among policies with >=20 trades; if none qualify select highest net among policies with trades for diagnosis. Never select empty cash as profitable.
holdout_selection_lock: Persist selected policy and its hash before opening final labels. Test only that policy and its predeclared unfiltered baseline.
notes: Absorption is a trade-flow/price-response proxy. Historical replenishment and MBO are not available and are not claimed.
Require later closed-bar price/Delta confirmation; no entry at the retrospectively identified event low.
Fit/calibration/validation/test boundaries purge labels using the full maximum holding horizon, including stress.
Fee remains 0.1% each side. Limit orders or discounts are not assumed.
Rule-only variants are predefined quantitative benchmarks and candidates; probabilities are reported for every variant.

No forward trading unless validation and final test are positive, sample gates pass, PF>=1.2, doubled-slippage result positive, daily CI lower>0, drawdown<=5%, and probability calibration no worse than constant when probabilities control entry.
2026-02-24 through 2026-10-21 are previously consumed. This study uses an earlier disjoint interval; later market transfer would still need fresh forward confirmation.

amendments_before_return_evaluation.reason: Initial 180-day feature-only count: 230 candidates (102/48/44/36 across initial stages); per-strategy 30-day holdout would be too small. Expanded before any strategy returns or model fit were inspected.

audit_sampling: 6 evenly spaced signal events per chronological 180-day half; 12 minutes total, no outcomes used
